verdict.rationale: Plaid's Dashboard shows per-session status, document/risk-check details and largest risk factors, and lets an ops user override a failed result — evidence of case-level visibility and manual intervention (plaid-idv-docs-19, plaid-idv-docs-20, plaid-idv-docs-7, plaid-idv-docs-11). However, there is no explicit description of a dedicated 'manual review queue' that routes borderline cases, nor documented reviewer-decision feedback loop updating the verification record beyond override/retry actions. Missing for 10: dedicated review-queue UI/workflow for borderline cases, explicit reviewer-decision audit trail feeding back into downstream record beyond override/retry.
